import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b'\n')
    totals = {}
    get = totals.get
    for line in data[1:]:
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.rstrip(b'\r').split(b',')
        if len(parts) < 3:
            continue
        cat = parts[1]
        v = parts[2]
        # exact cents as integer
        c = round(float(v) * 100)
        totals[cat] = get(cat, 0) + c
    out = []
    for cat in sorted(totals):
        c = totals[cat]
        sign = '-' if c < 0 else ''
        c = abs(c)
        out.append('%s%s,%d.%02d' % (sign, cat.decode(), c // 100, c % 100))
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out) + ('\n' if out else ''))


main()
